description: Drive to the CONFIRMED door nearest the car and stop in it, facing the way through. Needs a door detector publishing /perception/doors_semantic (door_source picks which one; 'freespace' is the stack default) and global localization; with no confirmed door within 5 s the move fails door_not_found and the mission aborts. The move runs in two phases: it first drives to a pre-point 0.8 m back on the door's own axis, carrying the door's yaw, so the car is square to the opening before it reaches the jambs, then straight down that axis to the origin; the pre-point is skipped if the car is already in the doorway. Entered means the car is within 0.15 m of the door frame's origin ALONG its own x axis (through the opening) and within 0.05 m of that same axis SIDEWAYS (the jamb-clearance budget), and within 10 deg of the axis itself -- standing in the doorway, pointing through it, NOT on the far side, and never during the approach phase. This along/lateral split replaces a single xy_tol radius, which let the car read as 'entered' while sitting flush against a jamb.
